data.content_ref: inline:The problem explicitly instructs to answer 'drawing on published definitions' distinguishing idempotent from safe operations, and even provides a research-fetch mechanism with a frozen allowlist (docs.python.org) so that 'fetched pages become citable evidence blocks.' SRC_001 provides zero published definitions, zero citations, and proposes no directed research fetches. Its formalization_refs, simulation_refs, and definitions arrays are all empty. It instead invents its own framework ('duplicate detectability') without grounding the idempotent-vs-safe distinction in any published source. While the substantive argument may be reasonable, the target fails the problem as stated because it never draws on published definitions to characterize the distinction — a core requirement of the question.
